title: Known-object test, TOI-5302.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-5302.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, not recovered, recovered (12 covered epochs). Residual screen: 0 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 2 light curve(s).
